prompt: Create an original 60 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 148 BPM; C major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and energetic electronic track with a distinct chiptune aesthetic. It features bright, arpeggiated synth melodies, a driving electronic drum beat, and a prominent synth bassline, evoking a retro video game or arcade feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼且充满活力的电子音乐，具有独特的芯片音乐美学。它包含明亮、琶音的合成器旋律、强劲的电子鼓点和突出的合成器低音线，唤起复古视频游戏或街机厅的感觉。
